name: Tuesday Night Worlds (A, B and C rides)
schedule: Tuesdays, spring to the fall time change: 5:30 pm in summer, 5:00 pm in early and late season. A, B and C rides start from different places each week, so check the Pedal Durango calendar. Last ride on the calendar: Oct 27.

start_location.name: Varies weekly: Bread (42 County Rd 250) or Sweeney's (1644 County Rd 203), by ride

pace: A: strenuous. B: hard but slower than A. C: slower, no-drop until the last quarter.

visitor_notes: The A and B rides meet at different places, and the start moves week to week. Lights for the 5:00 pm October starts.
description: Durango's Tuesday-night road ride, started about 35 years ago by local pros and still fast. The A ride is strenuous, the B ride is a hard group ride at a lesser pace, and the C ride is slower and no-drop until the last quarter. Routes run the Animas Valley, with climbs like Hermosa and Old Shalona.
